payload.title: omp-guard-precise and purview-guard-precise built off plan/purview-routes, not line(guard-precision)
payload.body: Met while integrating pre-call-refusal-holds of plan guard-precision. Branches unit/omp-guard-precise (79e6f36c) and unit/purview-guard-precise (cbac6a5f) stand on cbac6a5f, the head of plan/purview-routes, which is closed but not released (8 commits not in main). line(guard-precision) = plan/guard-precision was cut at 15d0a621. Merging either unit onto the line would carry purview-routes' unreleased commits (its records and closed-plan-route work) onto the guard-precision line. The integrator neither rebases nor repairs; the unit's implementer or the architect decides whether to rebuild off plan/guard-precision or release purview-routes first.
